image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a white cloth diaper with colorful printed patterns (blue and red shapes/characters). The diaper is bunched up, showing elasticized leg openings with gathered ruffles. The material appears to be soft fabric rather than the smooth plastic of disposable diapers. There are no visible adhesive tabs, suggesting it is a pull-on style or the tabs are hidden.
